name: [🎃EVENT] Poly Loot⚔️
desc:
🌟 Welcome to Poly Loot! 🌟

Fight monsters, collect powerful loot, and become stronger as you explore new areas!

How to play?
⚔️ Defeat monsters
💎 Collect loot
🛡️ Equip better gear
⭐ Level up and upgrade your stats

🔔 New worlds, enemies, equipment, and more added in every update!

📱 Available on Desktop, Mobile, and Console.
